title: Kernelcon Escape Room
author: Falkor Security
description:
Welcome to Kernelcon's third annual escape room—built for the off-grid mindset. The grid is unreliable, the uplink is gone, and you're cut off from the usual tools and comforts. Someone left behind a trail of analog clues, improvised gear, and half-finished comms—enough to piece together what went wrong and how to get a signal out before time runs out.

Teams of six have 30 minutes to work like a field crew: follow the breadcrumbs, improvise with what's on hand, and escape the room before the clock wins. No cloud saves. No easy answers. Just you, your crew, and whatever the last people rigged up when they went dark. Gather your friends and see if you can thrive off-grid.

title: Kernelcon Corn Cob Catcher
author: Kernelcon
description:
How to play the Kernelcon Corn Cob Catcher
  1. Press the top doorbell to turn on the magnets.
  2. Attach the corn cobs to the magnets. If you take too long the magnets will shut off to prevent overheating.
  3. When ready press the second button to start a 5 second timer before they begin randomly dropping.
  4. Attempt to catch all the corn cobs.
  5. Return the corn cobs to the basket when done.
Please don't steal the corn cobs :)

title: Kernelcon Capture the Flag
author: Kernelcon
description: Our annual Kernelcon Capture the Flag roars back stronger than ever, throwing competitors into a post-apocalyptic digital wasteland where only skill, grit, and community keep the engines running. This year, it's all about the Tribe—your war rig, your crew, your family—banding together to survive the ruins of broken systems, dead code, and hostile networks. Battle through challenges in web hacking, reversing, pwning, cryptography, and more as you scavenge Flags from the ashes and climb the Thunderdome leaderboard. The competition will be brutal, the exploits unforgiving, and only one crew will ride eternal, earning the coveted Eternal Kernel badges. Do you have the rig to survive the wasteland? If so, witness us at Kernelcon CTF.
